exposure: chronobiological variables (midline estimating statistic of rhythm (MESOR), glucose M10 start-time)
outcome: hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (preeclampsia with severe features)
cohort: The study included 92 pregnant patients with Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) data.
finding: A 3-covariate model incorporating chronobiological metrics (MESOR and glucose M10 start-time) and age was predictive of adverse neonatal outcomes and associated with several maternal and newborn secondary outcomes.
mod_finding: The predictive model was associated with cesarean delivery as a secondary maternal outcome.
